sanitization.policy: Replace absolute integration-worktree, M1-worktree and user-profile prefixes with <worktree>, <m1-worktree> and <user-home>; reject unclassified absolute local paths. Preserve relative source paths, official reference URLs, loopback endpoints, model digests, all answers and every numeric measurement.
sanitization.result: No absolute local paths were present in these three originals. Copies are byte-for-byte identical to their originals; no substitutions or omissions were necessary.
sanitization.secretScan: All JSON string values checked for private keys, GitHub tokens, OpenAI token patterns, AWS access keys, Google API keys and credential-bearing HTTP URLs; no matches. This is a pattern scan, not a comprehensive secret-detection guarantee.

timingCaveat: In nvidia-benchmark.json, legacy case/indexBuild/retrieval elapsedS includes resource-monitor shutdown/cleanup and must not be treated as isolated answer latency. The individual calls[].elapsedS for /api/chat and /api/embed remain measured HTTP-call latencies; Ollama duration/count fields retain their original units and values. Runtime response.elapsedS is separately measured end-to-end HTTP response latency.
omissions: None. No large raw resource-sample arrays are present in these summary artifacts; all existing arrays and fields are retained.
scope: Single-machine local measurements and prepared questions. Preserve recorded failed/truncated results and semantic-review limitations; passing structural gates do not certify generated scientific truth.

derivedArtifacts.provenance: Fresh base-only archived-checkout replay and actual browser counters; selected fields and original M2 report.
Allowlisted actual isolated CUDA log lines plus raw measured model residency; source-log SHA included.
